title: Headnote for 3017E, 1000.02163 – Work Rules
text:
1000.00000 – SCOPE OF REPRESENTATION
1000.02163 – Work Rules

School district’s ban on the display of “flags,” broadly defined, was a dress code in certain applications, and thus negotiable. (p. 29.)
